description:
Pressing shift+T should toggle label timestamps in tree entries. This feature is not implemented in Elixir.

## Upstream behavior (tree-selector.ts TreeList)

### State
- showLabelTimestamps: boolean (default false)

### Keybinding
- app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp (default: shift+t)
- Toggles showLabelTimestamps; no filter reapplication needed (render only)

### Entry rendering
When showLabelTimestamps is true and a node has both a label and a labelTimestamp, a formatted
timestamp is inserted between the label and content:
```
  [label] HH:MM content...
  [label] M/D HH:MM content...       (different day, same year)
  [label] YY/M/D HH:MM content...    (different year)
```
Styled: theme.fg("muted", "HH:MM ")

### formatLabelTimestamp(timestamp: string): string
Formats an ISO timestamp relative to now:
- Same day: "HH:MM"
- Same year, different day: "M/D HH:MM"  (1-indexed month, no padding)
- Different year: "YY/M/D HH:MM"  (2-digit year)

### Count line status suffix
When showLabelTimestamps is true, " [+label time]" is appended to the (N/N) status label
(this is handled by getStatusLabels() which is already referenced in opi-ce3.4).

## Elixir gaps

- No show_label_timestamps field in TreeSelector struct
- No app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp handler in handle_key/2
- No label timestamp rendering in render_node/4 (entry lines only show [label])
- No format_label_timestamp/1 function
- (N/N) status line does not show [+label time] suffix

## Where to fix

apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/tree_selector.ex:
- Add show_label_timestamps: false to struct
- Add app.tree.toggleLabelTimestamp handler in handle_key/2
- Pass show_label_timestamps option to Tree.render_lines/2

apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/components/tree_selector.ex:
- Add show_label_timestamps: false option to render_lines/2
- In render_node/4, emit label_timestamp between label and content when enabled
- Add format_label_timestamp/1 private function (mirror formatLabelTimestamp in upstream)

## Upstream references
- toggleLabelTimestamp keybinding handler line 985 in tree-selector.ts
- Label timestamp rendering in render() lines 667-673 in tree-selector.ts
- formatLabelTimestamp() lines 793-813 in tree-selector.ts
- getStatusLabels() with [+label time] lines 565-582 in tree-selector.ts

## Verification
Open /tree with at least one labeled entry (use shift+L first if needed). Press shift+T.
Confirm timestamp appears next to the label: [label] HH:MM content.
Confirm (N/N) changes to (N/N) [+label time]. Press shift+T again to toggle off.
title: /tree label timestamp toggle: shift+T and formatLabelTimestamp
